contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN CONSTAN-TIVS P F AVG ; R/ VOTIS/XXX/MVLTIS/XXXX

A silver Roman siliqua of Constantius II (AD 337-361) dating to the period c.AD 359-361 (Reece period 18). VOTIS/XXX/MVLTIS/XXXX reverse type depicting legend within wreath. Mint of Lugdunum. RIC VIII, p. 183, no. 216. Obverse description: Pearl-diademed, draped bust right. Obverse inscription: DN CONSTAN-TIVS P F AVG. Reverse description: Votive inscription within wreath.
